candidate_hypotheses.why_uncatalogued_faults: USGS/INGENIOUS Quaternary fault traces heavily favor subaerial bedrock and range-front scarps. Concealed intrabasin stepovers, accommodation-zone transfer structures, and piedmont relay faults lose topographic scarps beneath Holocene alluvial/playa veneers (low Band 19) yet retain basement density steps (g_zz hinge) and hydrothermal magnetite destruction along permeable damage zones.
